delete_only_after: X0-X14 evidential review gates complete or explicitly blocked without concealing high/critical risks
Each file in review-queue.json has reviewed/reviewed_limited/blocked disposition and rationale
All mandatory iPhone acceptance verified or exposed as unresolved blocker
Durable concise technical record archived in user-approved GitHub location
Explicit user approval to delete review files or branch
method: On review branch, create tree entries {path,mode:'100644',type:'blob',sha:null} for every tracked review-root file; create deletion commit and fast-forward ref after checking expected SHA. Verify review folder absent. Delete review branch through GitHub UI only if connector lacks delete-ref support.
caveat: Deleting a folder in Git does NOT securely erase historical blobs/commits; never commit private user data at any stage.
next_action: Retain all review records until X15 and separately approved cleanup. Deleting Git files does not securely erase Git history.
